name: Yurivania 3: Circle of the Polycule
summary:
Never's polycule has been chatting via magic mirror for months, but most of them haven't met in person. An upcoming eclipse is the perfect opportunity to summon them all to the Midnight Palace and go on a group date!

Now it's a matter of balancing all their schedules, carefully researching the right mystic glyphs, and invoking dread powers to bring everyone together!

Async flirting and remote emotional support are one thing, but will a mushroomgirl, slimemould, machinegirl, scarecrow, mystery witch, and void-horror all get along face-to-face?? They will if Never has anything to say about it!
